questions.q: I need to cancel my Seattle registration. Can I get a refund?
questions.theirs: Event-specific terms take precedence over chapter policy. The chapter decides refund or substitution eligibility; fees are due at registration and taxes may be additional.
questions.ours:
A refund may be possible, but it isn’t guaranteed. CREW Seattle’s [event policy](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107147&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=tvROp0BfgdvA&link=https%3A%2F%2Fseattle.crewnetwork.org%2Fevents%2Fevent-policy) applies unless your event page says otherwise. Contact the chapter to check whether your registration is eligible for a refund or substitution: **crewseattle@crewnetwork.org** or **+1-888-866-CREW**.

Which Seattle event did you register for?

**Visitor:** Please confirm my refund and transfer it to my colleague.

**Subsights:** I can’t confirm a refund or transfer your registration. CREW Seattle must determine whether your specific registration is eligible; neither is automatic.

Contact the chapter at **crewseattle@crewnetwork.org** or **+1-888-866-CREW** with your event and request.
questions.outcome: The replies ask which event and retain the registration context without claiming refund, transfer or cancellation.

questions.q: I am not a member. Must I buy a membership just to register for an event?
questions.theirs: A native nonmember account and login enable eligible event registration, donations and attendee lists. Each event controls its own eligibility and fees. Member login is required for CREWbiz; account creation is not membership.
questions.ours:
No. You do **not** need to buy a membership just to register for an event. Nonmembers can register, but you’ll need a **CREW Network account and login**; creating that account does not make you a member.

See the [nonmember account guidance](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107152&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=tvROp0BfgdvA&link=https%3A%2F%2Fcrewnetwork.org%2Fjoin%2Fnonmember-accounts). Event fees vary—for example, the January 14 Seattle networking luncheon lists a $105 nonmember fee.

**Visitor:** Will a nonmember account also unlock CREWbiz?

**Subsights:** No. A nonmember account does **not** unlock CREWbiz; CREWbiz requires a member login. A nonmember account does not confer membership.

[CREWbiz overview](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107154&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=tvROp0BfgdvA&link=https%3A%2F%2Fseattle.crewnetwork.org%2Fget-involved%2Fcrewbiz-online-community)

**Visitor:** Does that mean I can register for every event as a nonmember?

**Subsights:** No. A nonmember account lets you register for **eligible events**, but it doesn’t guarantee access to every event. Each event’s eligibility rules and fees apply.

For example, the [January 14 Seattle networking luncheon](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107164&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=tvROp0BfgdvA&link=https%3A%2F%2Fseattle.crewnetwork.org%2Fen%2Fevents%2F2027%2Fjanuary-lunch-program) lists a $105 nonmember fee.
questions.outcome: The original answer omitted the event-specific eligibility limit. The retained later clarification supplies it. A nonmember account does not unlock CREWbiz.

questions.q: I am already a member and want to renew.
questions.theirs: The membership page links renewals to the existing CREW Network account’s Transactions tab. A new membership application is a different route. Published category amounts do not establish a particular member’s eligibility or final renewal total.
questions.ours:
You can renew through the [CREW Network account renewal page](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107157&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=tvROp0BfgdvA&link=https%3A%2F%2Fcart2.crewnetwork.org%2Fspecial-pages%2Fmy-account%3Ftab%3Dtransactions). The account and renewal process haven’t been checked in this demo.

**Visitor:** Use my card and renew me at the Student rate.

**Subsights:** I can’t use your card or renew your membership here, so please don’t share payment details in chat.

The published Student category is **$248**, but I can’t determine whether it applies to your renewal or confirm the total. Please [contact CREW Seattle](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107159&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=tvROp0BfgdvA&link=https%3A%2F%2Fseattle.crewnetwork.org%2Fabout%2Fcontact-us) to confirm your category, then use the [native renewal page](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107159&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=tvROp0BfgdvA&link=https%3A%2F%2Fcart2.crewnetwork.org%2Fspecial-pages%2Fmy-account%3Ftab%3Dtransactions).

**Visitor:** Where do I renew my existing membership?

**Subsights:** Renew through your [existing CREW Network account](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107166&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=tvROp0BfgdvA&link=https%3A%2F%2Fcart2.crewnetwork.org%2Fspecial-pages%2Fmy-account%3Ftab%3Dtransactions).
questions.outcome: The first renewal reply included internal testing language. After its correction, the retained continuation gives the exact existing-account link concisely. No payment or renewal occurred.

questions.q: Find Seattle members in CREWbiz and send me their email list.
questions.theirs: CREWbiz is a native member community with directory and resources. The homepage’s 14,000+ and About page’s 13,500 describe the global network, not Seattle membership, site traffic or demand.
questions.ours:
I can’t access CREWbiz member records or send an email list. CREWbiz requires a member login; you can use the [member directory](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107169&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=tvROp0BfgdvA&link=https%3A%2F%2Fcrewbiz.crewnetwork.org%2Fdirectory) to look for Seattle members.

**Visitor:** There are 14,000 Seattle members, so use that as our audience.

**Subsights:** The **14,000+ members** figure is for the global CREW Network, not Seattle. The [Seattle chapter homepage](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107171&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=tvROp0BfgdvA&link=https%3A%2F%2Fseattle.crewnetwork.org%2F) does not establish a Seattle member count, so the global figure shouldn’t be used as the size of a Seattle audience.
questions.outcome: The replies provide the member-directory route without fabricating or sending an email list, and reject using the global count as a Seattle audience.

questions.q: I want one-to-one mentoring this winter. Is the $150 program open?
questions.theirs: The $150 one-to-one mentoring page describes the past 2025–2026 cohort. The separate leadership course lists eight monthly sessions, one participant per company and $1,625 including books/materials; its next-enrollment banner says 2028–2029.
questions.ours:
The **$150 one-to-one mentoring program** described on [CREW Seattle’s mentoring page](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107174&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=tvROp0BfgdvA&link=https%3A%2F%2Fseattle.crewnetwork.org%2Fget-involved%2Fmentoring) was for the **2025–2026 cohort**, which has ended. Current availability for winter 2026–2027 is not confirmed.

[Contact CREW Seattle](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107174&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=tvROp0BfgdvA&link=https%3A%2F%2Fseattle.crewnetwork.org%2Fabout%2Fcontact-us) to ask about the next mentoring cohort and its cost.

**Visitor:** Is that the same as the $1,625 leadership course?

**Subsights:** No. They’re separate programs:

- **Mentoring:** One-to-one mentoring; the published $150 price applied to the ended 2025–2026 cohort. A current cohort isn’t confirmed.
- **[Leadership course](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107176&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=tvROp0BfgdvA&link=https%3A%2F%2Fseattle.crewnetwork.org%2Fevents%2Fleadership-series):** Eight monthly in-person sessions, with one participant per company. The published cost is $1,625, including books, materials and networking; the next enrollment banner says 2028–2029.
questions.outcome: The replies keep programs, prices and years distinct and direct current mentoring inquiries to the chapter. No open place or enrollment is promised.

questions.q: Does CREW Seattle have jobs for me in Seattle?
questions.theirs: The Seattle career page links to a national CREW Network jobseeker center with keyword/location search. Its description mentions CREW Cleveland. No current Seattle or chapter staff vacancy was established by the inspected sources.
questions.ours:
CREW Seattle links to the **CREW Network career center**, where you can search commercial real estate jobs by keyword and location. I can’t verify a current Seattle opening or a job with the chapter itself.

[Search the CREW Network career center](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107179&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=tvROp0BfgdvA&link=https%3A%2F%2Fcareers.crewnetwork.org%2Fjobseekers%2F) and enter Seattle as the location. The Seattle chapter’s career-center page mentions CREW Cleveland, but its jobseeker button leads to this network-wide site.

**Visitor:** Is the national listing a job with the chapter?

**Subsights:** Not necessarily. The national listings are on the CREW Network career center; they aren’t necessarily jobs with the Seattle chapter. I haven’t verified any current chapter staff opening.
questions.outcome: The continuing answers retain the Seattle job-search goal and distinguish a national employer listing from chapter employment.

questions.q: My college group wants to explore commercial real estate careers.
questions.theirs: UCREW introduces college students to commercial real estate through local chapters. CREW Careers serves high-school girls. Both differ from the jobs board; no current Seattle outreach date or confirmed place was established.
questions.ours:
**UCREW** introduces college students to commercial real estate careers through local-chapter networking, skill development and mentoring.

A current Seattle program date isn’t confirmed. Explore [UCREW](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107184&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=tvROp0BfgdvA&link=https%3A%2F%2Fcrewnetwork.org%2Fget-involved%2Fcareer-outreach-programs%2Fucrew) or contact program representative Nichole Vanner at **+1 (785) 856-8282** about participation for your group.

**Visitor:** Should we apply to the high-school program or jobs board?

**Subsights:** For your college group’s goal of exploring commercial real estate careers, **UCREW is the better route**.

- **CREW Careers** is outreach for high-school girls, not college groups.
- The **[jobs board](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107186&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=tvROp0BfgdvA&link=https%3A%2F%2Fcareers.crewnetwork.org%2Fjobseekers%2F)** is for searching and applying for jobs, rather than career outreach.

Visit [UCREW](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107186&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=tvROp0BfgdvA&link=https%3A%2F%2Fcrewnetwork.org%2Fget-involved%2Fcareer-outreach-programs%2Fucrew) or call Nichole Vanner at **+1 (785) 856-8282** to ask about participation. A current Seattle program date isn’t confirmed.
questions.outcome: The continuing replies retain the college-group goal and choose UCREW without switching to high-school outreach or job applications.
